newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Bacnotan Cement says Q1 net up 45 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bacnotan Cement says Q1 net up 45 pct.

text.p: Bacnotan Cement Corp said on Wednesday net income rose 45 percent in the first quarter ended September 30 to 57.6 million pesos.
Bacnotan Cement said in a statement that its net sales rose by 29 percent to 521.7 million pesos for the period July to September 1996.
The company added that due to strong market demand and favourable prices, sales volume rose by 20 percent to 6.2 million bags for the quarter.
